cases.title: Paid generation to durable delivery
cases.steps: Use a restricted QA account and an approved spending limit. Confirm two candidates from a v3 prompt, audition both, publish one and cancel the other. Send the saved candidate to the Resolve playhead. Quit SoundPlus and reopen the receiving project.
cases.expected: Provider billing and candidate IDs reconcile. The selected WAV hash, copied or referenced path, track, first frame and reopened online item agree. A missing credential or declined confirmation produces zero paid submissions.

cases.title: Transform a marked region with upload consent
cases.steps: Mark a half-open interval in a multichannel fixture. Review provider, exact samples, roles and upload size. Decline once, then use an approved account. Interrupt polling after submission, resume, and insert the result in Edit.
cases.expected: Capture shows zero audio bytes sent before consent and one billable job after consent. Polling resumes the same receipt. Source WAV and excluded channels are preserved. Undo and reopen target the same generated candidate.

cases.title: Refined match to edited and automated mix
cases.steps: Find Similar on a transient, review alternate event boundaries, use I/O to edit, insert in a routed track, automate a creative effect and hide its lane. Render across the edit.
cases.expected: Compared with independent PCM, the clip equals the chosen sample interval, hidden automation plays, latency and tails match the declared graph, and collection membership still references the original. Record human boundary assessment separately.

cases.title: Physical performance to portable frozen take
cases.steps: Trigger, steal and switch pooled sources using a physical MIDI controller while recording a four-pad take. Disconnect the controller, save the consumed prefix, collect consented assets and open on a second Mac with original volumes offline.
cases.expected: Note sequence, source IDs, roles, overlap, frozen event hash and rendered PCM match the receipt. Portable lineage is traceable. Missing or unauthorized assets prevent false publication.

cases.title: Mixer and surround stems into Resolve
cases.steps: Render dry track, FX Return and master in stereo and both 5.1 layouts. Check masks and role pulses. Physically drag a finalized stem and send another at 29.97 DF. Save, quit SoundPlus, close and reopen Resolve.
cases.expected: Independent reader verifies role order and samples. Resolve confirms distinct media IDs, chosen safe tracks, record frames, actual paths and usable reopened media. Record speaker listening on a calibrated chain separately.

cases.title: Catalog migration to offline reuse
cases.steps: Upgrade a clone of a real older catalog, retain user tags across a changed embedded header and source reconnect, page a large scoped results set while auditioning, and reopen a saved smart filter after new media is indexed.
cases.expected: Stable asset and bookmark IDs, source hashes, pins and exact sample ranges survive. Updated source requires review and private tags remain visible. Report timings and audible continuity separately.

cases.title: Interrupted package, recording and release upgrade
cases.steps: Simulate disk exhaustion in an isolated volume while recording or collecting. Recover the newest journal; install and roll back the distributable in a clean account using a cloned project.
cases.expected: Originals, saved projects, take recipes, current journal and finalized exports match the audit. Partial artifacts remain unpublished. The old version refuses an incompatible schema safely. Signed/stapled package and authorized clean install are evidenced.
